zh.role:shen:passage:line: 我负责今晚的宾客名单。停电前，我一直在东侧酒廊。
zh.role:shen:passage:answer:time: 东侧酒廊的监控能证明我在那里。至少，大部分时间可以。
zh.role:shen:passage:answer:motive: 如果宝石丢失，画廊会失去下一轮融资。我比任何人都希望它还在。
zh.role:shen:passage:answer:key: 展柜钥匙只有馆长和修复师碰过，我没有理由接近它。
zh.role:gu:passage:line: 我来这里只是为了确认一份遗嘱。宝石和我没有关系。
zh.role:gu:passage:answer:time: 我在电话里处理一桩继承案。时间很长，长到足够让我错过很多事情。
zh.role:gu:passage:answer:motive: 真正的动机不在宝石，而在它附带的保险金。你应该去问沈鸢。
zh.role:gu:passage:answer:key: 那把银色小钥匙？我在二楼书房见过，但没有拿过。
zh.role:he:passage:line: 展柜的锁没有被破坏。有人用了正确的密码，但这不代表是我。
zh.role:he:passage:answer:time: 我在工作室清理一幅画。雨水从窗边进来，我擦了很久。
zh.role:he:passage:answer:motive: 修复师只能靠作品活着。毁掉一件藏品，对我没有好处。
zh.role:he:passage:answer:key: 密码每月更换一次。今晚的密码只有馆长知道——除非有人看过她的记录。
zh.role:su:passage:line: 我正在写一篇关于这间画廊的报道。今晚发生的事，正好给了我一个标题。
zh.role:su:passage:answer:time: 我在洗手间外录音。有人经过，但灯光太暗，我只听到鞋跟声。
zh.role:su:passage:answer:motive: 我只需要一个真相，不需要一颗宝石。除非真相本身能卖个好价钱。
zh.role:su:passage:answer:key: 我拍到过密码本的一角。上面有一个被划掉的日期：21/17。
zh.role:luo:passage:line: 我守的是门，不是展柜。没有人从正门带着宝石离开。
zh.role:luo:passage:answer:time: 21:12 到 21:19，主厅摄像头短暂断线。有人让我去检查配电箱。
zh.role:luo:passage:answer:motive: 我只收安保费。别把失职和盗窃混在一起。
zh.role:luo:passage:answer:key: 展柜的警报在 21:17 被正常解除，权限记录显示是内部账号。

en.role:shen:passage:line: I handled the guest list. Before the blackout, I stayed in the east lounge.
en.role:shen:passage:answer:time: The east lounge cameras can place me there—at least for most of the night.
en.role:shen:passage:answer:motive: If the stone disappears, the gallery loses its next round of funding. I need it found more than anyone.
en.role:shen:passage:answer:key: Only the curator and restorer handled the case key. I had no reason to go near it.
en.role:gu:passage:line: I came to confirm a will. The stone has nothing to do with me.
en.role:gu:passage:answer:time: I was on a long inheritance call—long enough to miss several things.
en.role:gu:passage:answer:motive: The motive is not the stone but the insurance. Ask Shen Yuan.
en.role:gu:passage:answer:key: I saw the small silver key in the upstairs study, but I never took it.
en.role:he:passage:line: The lock was not forced. Someone used the right code, but that does not make it me.
en.role:he:passage:answer:time: I was cleaning a painting in the studio. Rain came through the window, so I stayed there.
en.role:he:passage:answer:motive: A restorer survives by protecting works. Destroying one would make no sense for me.
en.role:he:passage:answer:key: The code changes monthly. Only the curator knew tonight's code—unless someone read her notes.
en.role:su:passage:line: I was reporting on the gallery. Tonight's incident practically wrote the headline.
en.role:su:passage:answer:time: I was recording outside the washroom. I heard heels, but the light was too poor to see who passed.
en.role:su:passage:answer:motive: I need a truth, not a stone—unless the truth itself can pay well.
en.role:su:passage:answer:key: I photographed a corner of the code book. One date had been crossed out: 21/17.
en.role:luo:passage:line: I guard the doors, not the display case. No one left through the front entrance with the stone.
en.role:luo:passage:answer:time: From 21:12 to 21:19, the main camera went dark. Someone sent me to check the power box.
en.role:luo:passage:answer:motive: I am paid for security. Do not confuse negligence with theft.
en.role:luo:passage:answer:key: The alarm was dismissed normally at 21:17. The credential belonged to an internal account.

zh.role:ye:passage:answer:time: 涨潮前我一直在二号码头清点木箱，工人都看见了。
zh.role:ye:passage:answer:motive: 那封信会让很多人失去现在的身份，但我已经不在乎过去。
zh.role:ye:passage:answer:key: 灯塔钥匙挂在档案室墙上，江屿比我更熟悉那面墙。
zh.role:tang:passage:line: 旧港每年都有失踪的货物，不代表和一封信有关。
zh.role:tang:passage:answer:time: 我在海关办公室打电话，处理一份遗失货单。
zh.role:tang:passage:answer:motive: 信里的名字如果公开，航运公司的旧账会全部被翻出来。
zh.role:tang:passage:answer:key: 铜钥匙原本属于灯塔管理员，后来由江屿代为保管。
zh.role:jiang:passage:line: 灯塔已经停用很多年了，那里没有值得看的东西。
zh.role:jiang:passage:answer:time: 我在北堤检查发电机，雨太大，没人愿意过去。
zh.role:jiang:passage:answer:motive: 那封信只是一个误会，真正的秘密早就被海水带走了。
zh.role:jiang:passage:answer:key: 钥匙一直在档案室，我只在上个月借过一次。
zh.role:wan:passage:line: 我播报的是天气，不是二十年前的家族故事。
zh.role:wan:passage:answer:time: 我在电台录潮汐预报，录音带可以证明时间。
zh.role:wan:passage:answer:motive: 旧信里的人名很适合做一期节目，但我还没拿到它。
zh.role:wan:passage:answer:key: 邮戳日期被擦过，和今晚潮汐表上的数字很像。
zh.role:qiao:passage:line: 仓库的门锁完好，没有人从正门带走任何东西。
zh.role:qiao:passage:answer:time: 我在南门值班，只有江屿拿着维修通行证进过内港。
zh.role:qiao:passage:answer:motive: 我只想保住这份工作，不想卷入旧案。
zh.role:qiao:passage:answer:key: 封条上的蜡不是港务处的颜色，是维修组常用的蓝蜡。

en.host:host:passage:intro: The old port's tide will flood the warehouse cellar in an hour. Tonight, a letter that was never sent twenty years ago appears in the lighthouse archive—and its true recipient has just died at the harbor.
en.host:host:passage:evidenceLead: Before the tide rises, the dock warehouse remains sealed.
en.host:host:passage:evidenceCopy: Every item records a relationship partly washed away by the sea. First find where the letter came from, then decide who is most afraid of it being read.

en.host:host:passage:voteCopy: The right answer must explain the lighthouse key, the tide record and the postmark that was never sent.
en.host:host:passage:resultText: Correct. Jiang Yu forged the lighthouse seal record and planned to take the old letter before the cellar flooded. The salt inside the envelope and fresh scratches on the brass key exposed him.

en.host:host:passage:evidence:tide: The tide rose twelve minutes earlier than the official record. Only someone familiar with the old harbor gates would know that.
en.host:host:passage:evidence:seal: The wax came from the repair crew, not the harbor office. A freshly pressed old crest remains on its surface.
en.host:host:passage:evidence:letter: The letter mentions a shift change from twenty years ago. Its recipient is the first person to leave the harbor tonight.
en.host:host:passage:evidence:key: Fresh scratches on the teeth show that it recently opened a lock that had not been used for years.
en.host:host:passage:evidence:salt: The salt appears only inside the envelope, proving the letter was carried into a damp cellar rather than opened on a desk.
en.host:host:passage:evidence:stamp: The year was deliberately rubbed away, but blue-black ink remains—the same ink used in the repair crew's register.

en.role:ye:passage:line: I only store a few paintings for the port. I have no interest in old archives.
en.role:ye:passage:answer:time: Before high tide I was counting crates at Pier Two. The dockworkers all saw me.
en.role:ye:passage:answer:motive: That letter could cost many people the identities they have now, but I stopped caring about the past.
en.role:ye:passage:answer:key: The lighthouse key hangs on the archive-room wall. Jiang Yu knows that wall better than I do.
en.role:tang:passage:line: The old port loses cargo every year. That does not make a letter relevant.
en.role:tang:passage:answer:time: I was on the phone in the customs office, handling a missing cargo report.
en.role:tang:passage:answer:motive: If the names in the letter become public, the shipping company's old accounts will be exposed.
en.role:tang:passage:answer:key: The brass key belonged to the lighthouse keeper. Jiang Yu kept it after taking over repairs.
en.role:jiang:passage:line: The lighthouse has been closed for years. There is nothing worth seeing there.
en.role:jiang:passage:answer:time: I was checking the generator on the north breakwater. The rain was too heavy for anyone to come over.
en.role:jiang:passage:answer:motive: The letter is just a misunderstanding. The real secret was carried away by the sea long ago.
en.role:jiang:passage:answer:key: The key has always been in the archive room. I only borrowed it once last month.
en.role:wan:passage:line: I broadcast weather reports, not twenty-year-old family stories.
en.role:wan:passage:answer:time: I was recording the tide forecast at the station. The tape can prove the time.
en.role:wan:passage:answer:motive: The names in the old letter would make a good broadcast, but I never had it.
en.role:wan:passage:answer:key: The postmark was erased. Its numbers look like the figures on tonight's tide chart.
en.role:qiao:passage:line: The warehouse lock was intact. No one carried anything out through the front door.
en.role:qiao:passage:answer:time: I was posted at the south gate. Only Jiang Yu entered the inner harbor with a repair pass.
en.role:qiao:passage:answer:motive: I only want to keep my job. I do not want to be part of an old case.
en.role:qiao:passage:answer:key: The seal wax is not from the harbor office. It is the blue wax used by the repair crew.

en.host:host:passage:evidence:coolant: The particles drift in one direction in zero gravity, pointing to someone who left the maintenance module.
en.host:host:passage:evidence:clock: The battery was replaced moments ago. The old battery has not cooled down yet.

en.role:mu:passage:answer:time: During the blackout I restarted the coolant loop in the core module. The logs will show I never left.

en.role:lin:passage:answer:motive: If the incident is ruled human-made, I will lose command.
